sortieLines.line: The Congregation stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
⚔️ SORTIE — Wolfgang, Rodrigo, Priya take up arms and a day's rations (6,240 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ The Congregation mauled Wolfgang (-50 health) over 1 round. They're lucky to be breathing. — the party falls back to the palisade, dragging their nerve with them. The treeline holds.
